_comment: What a model returns for tests/fixtures/documents/sample_rfp.pdf. Quotes are copied the way a model sees them (single line, PDF line breaks removed). Three items are deliberately bad and must be dropped: an invented AWS clause, a real clause cited on the wrong page, and a duplicate of the support clause. `_seen_on_page` (stripped before returning) is the page whose excerpt the model was reading when it produced the item; defaults to page_number. Sprint 6 added page 4 (documents to be submitted): its `submission_documents` include an invented CMMI certificate and a duplicate of the ISO 27001 item, both of which must be dropped. `bid_draft` is the Sprint 6 draft-bid response, written for the profile used in tests/api/test_bid_preparation.py; it deliberately omits requirement R7, which must come back as a [TO FILL] row.

requirements.summary: 36-month contract from Go-Live including 12 months warranty
requirements.quote: The contract period shall be 36 months from the date of Go-Live, including 12 months of warranty support.
The solution shall be developed using an open-source technology stack with PostgreSQL as the database.

requirements.summary: Integrate with State Payment Gateway and DigiLocker via REST APIs
requirements.quote: The portal shall integrate with the State Payment Gateway and DigiLocker through secure REST APIs.
The bidder shall provide 24x7 helpdesk support with a maximum resolution time of 4 hours for critical incidents.

requirements.summary: CERT-In empanelled security audit before Go-Live
requirements.quote: The application must undergo a security audit by a CERT-In empanelled auditor before Go-Live.
Project Manager - 1 resource with minimum 10 years of experience in IT project delivery.

requirements.summary: 4 Java Developers with 5+ years experience each
requirements.quote: Java Developer - 4 resources with minimum 5 years of experience each.

requirements.quote: The solution shall be hosted on AWS GovCloud with Kubernetes orchestration.

requirements.quote: Java Developer - 4 resources with minimum 5 years of experience each.
The bidder shall provide 24x7 helpdesk support with a maximum resolution time of 4 hours for critical incidents.

eligibility.summary: Average annual turnover of at least ₹10 Cr over last 3 financial years
eligibility.quote: The bidder must have an average annual turnover of at least Rs. 10 Crore during the last three financial years.

eligibility.summary: 3 similar Government/PSU projects of at least ₹2 Cr each
eligibility.quote: The bidder must have successfully completed at least 3 similar projects, each of value not less than Rs. 2 Crore, for Government or PSU clients.
The bidder must hold a valid ISO 27001 certification.
Earnest Money Deposit of Rs. 5,00,000 shall be submitted along with the bid.

eligibility.quote: Micro and Small Enterprises registered with NSIC or Udyam are exempted from payment of EMD as per the Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order, 2012.
